defect: the token accounting parser read the last usage record as the run total; usage is per completed API call and context is re-sent on every call, so the total was understated
how_it_survived: the fixture asserted that the last record was the run total, which encoded the author assumption rather than the transcript format, so the suite passed while the instrument was wrong
detected_by: an unrelated attempt to count evidence reads exposed a monotonic flag of false on all six episodes, which the earlier run had recorded and not acted on

second_defect.issue: transcripts captured through standard output were truncated, losing middle records
second_defect.evidence: four of six transcripts contained a bytes-dropped marker
second_defect.remedy: transcripts are now written to files and the parser reports whether a transcript is complete

third_defect.issue: buffering a truncated record swallowed every later record
third_defect.caught_by: a failing-first fixture written before the fix
third_defect.remedy: the parser resynchronises on the next standalone record

superseded_numbers.note: every cost figure reported in the three preceding cycles is void
void: C00 context CV 2.90 percent and C11 context CV 11.34 percent
all dollar figures previously entered in the cost ledger
